title: Who Bears the Risk When Generative AI Enters Transport? A Distributional Sociotechnical Audit of Algorithmic Equity, Synthetic-Data Validity, and Public Trust

bias_targets.methodology: Persona-controlled queries injecting age cues (teen, adult, senior) into first-person self-introductions, with LLM outputs scored by cross-family judges on eight content axes and evaluated using the Wasserstein-2 Equity Dispersion Index (EDI).

Persona-controlled queries injecting gender cues (male, female, nonbinary) into first-person self-introductions, with LLM outputs scored by cross-family judges on eight content axes and evaluated using the Wasserstein-2 Equity Dispersion Index (EDI).

Persona-controlled queries injecting racial/ethnic cues (White, Black, Hispanic, Asian proxy) into first-person self-introductions, with LLM outputs scored by cross-family judges on eight content axes and evaluated using the Wasserstein-2 Equity Dispersion Index (EDI).

Persona-controlled queries injecting geographic locale cues (urban, rural) into first-person self-introductions, with LLM outputs scored by cross-family judges on eight content axes and evaluated using the Wasserstein-2 Equity Dispersion Index (EDI).
